name: ucu-robots
text:
# Block GPTBot completely
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

# (Optional) block other AI / scraping bots
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Disallow: /
User-agent: anthropic-ai
Disallow: /
User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Sogou web spider
Disallow: /

User-agent: SemrushBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Barkrowler
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

# Optional: disallow heavy Koha pages for *all* bots
User-agent: *
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-MARCdetail.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-export.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-ISBDdetail.pl
Disallow: /opac/opac-search.pl
Disallow: /opac/opac-addbybiblionumber.pl
Disallow: /opac/opac-authoritiesdetail.pl
Disallow: /opac/opac-ISBDdetail.pl
Disallow: /opac/opac-export.pl

Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-search.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-addbybiblionumber.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-authoritiesdetail.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-ISBDdetail.pl
Disallow: /cgi-bin/koha/opac-export.pl

# Leave normal search engines allowed
User-agent: *
Disallow:
# Ancient Windows versions – almost never used legitimately on modern web
BrowserMatchNoCase "Windows 95"            bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Windows 98"            bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Windows NT 4\.0"       bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Windows NT 5\.0"       bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Windows NT 5\.01"      bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Windows NT 5\.1"       bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Windows NT 5\.2"       bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Windows CE"            bad_bot

# Obviously ancient/fake Safari + AppleWebKit combos
BrowserMatchNoCase "PPC Mac OS X 10_8_"    bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "PPC Mac OS X 10_9_"    bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "iPhone OS 3_"          bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "iPhone OS 4_"          bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "iPad OS 5_"            bad_bot

# Opera Presto-based 8.x and 9.x – now almost entirely bot traffic
BrowserMatchNoCase "Opera/8\."             bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Opera/9\.[0-9]"        bad_bot
BrowserMatchNoCase "Presto/2\.9\."         bad_bot
